//: Renderer only. `types: []` keeps @types/node out. It is not a hard boundary: electron/preload.ts is listed below so the bridge stays single-sourced, and Electron's own .d.ts references the Node types, which drags NodeJS globals back in. The runtime guarantee is the sandbox itself, asserted by scripts/smoke-test.mjs — require, process and module are all undefined in the renderer. The boundary that this config does enforce is the other direction: no DOM in the main process.
//include: electron/preload.ts is listed here as well as in the node project: it defines the shape of window.api, and typing the renderer against anything else would let the two drift. Locale JSON needs an explicit glob because resolveJsonModule does not widen a directory include.
